conventions.user_meters: Core users are never billed, and requiring MFA never counts a user. Only enterprise SSO and directory integrations count users, once per project, connection or directory, and month, with a cap per connection or directory; threat intelligence counts the users checked against licensed feeds on the projects that turn it on.
conventions.allowance: The same allowance applies on every plan, per account and month; Enterprise contracts may raise it.
conventions.invoice: Pro base fee + metered integrations and consumption beyond included allowances + extra requests, contracted packages and support; the base fee includes Governance and is not usage credit
conventions.caps: Owners opt in to paid packages and consumption. Alerts at 50, 80 and 100 percent of a budget are notifications, not a hard spending cap. A budget never switches security enforcement off.
conventions.self_hosted: Self-hosted installs pay for rights and support per production installation and are never metered.
conventions.packages: Governance and custom security settings are included in Pro. Compliance is quoted per account, with retention duration, retained-event volume, SIEM destinations and any overage prices agreed before activation. No package charges per user or per policy.
